mapping.summary: Calculates safety stock, reorder point, EOQ and reorder policy from demand history.
claims: Safety stock from demand and lead-time variability at a chosen service level
Reorder point as lead-time demand plus safety stock
EOQ via Wilson formula respecting order modifiers
Recommends a reordering policy from demand pattern classification
Writes results to standard item fields used by planning and MRP
Worksheet compares current and proposed values and applies selected lines
Logs each calculation with statistics, lead time source, service level and reasoning
Warns on demand shifts, SKU overrides and intermittent demand
Runs per item, in bulk, from the worksheet or nightly via job queue
